values.note: Marquette County '2025 Rates & Fee Schedule' (still the posted schedule in October 2026; one rate for everyone): electric only $30, electric & water $40, full hook-up $50; rustic site $25, rustic tent $35, rustic yurt $80. $5 non-refundable reservation fee; $5 cancellation fee; early check-in or late check-out $10. Rates exclude service fees.

fees.source: https://www.co.marquette.mi.us/departments/planning/perkins_park/rates.php ('2025 Rates & Fee Schedule', 'Electric Only $30', 'Full Hook-Up $50', 'RESERVATION FEE- $5') + the signed 'Policies and Fees 2025' PDF (adopted 9-17-2024), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Reserve online on the county's ResNexus page ('RESERVE ONLINE!'), paid in full at booking; reservations for the next season open October 1. The three-night holiday minimum covers Memorial Day, Labor Day and Fire on the Bay weekends. A reserved site is held until 1 p.m. the day after the scheduled arrival. Check-in 3 p.m., check-out 11 a.m. Cancellations only by phone or voicemail to the park office.

booking.source: https://www.co.marquette.mi.us/departments/planning/perkins_park/ ('RESERVE ONLINE!' -> resnexus.com) + Policies and Fees 2025 PDF (rules 3, 7-9, 24 'The maximum length of stay per reservation is two weeks, 14 consecutive nights', 25 'Reservations for the following season can be made beginning October 1', 26 'A minimum three-night stay is required on Memorial Day, Labor Day, and Fire on the Bay weekends', 29d), read 2026-10-22

facilities.source: Policies and Fees 2025 PDF ('SHOWER FEE (NON-CAMPERS)- $2', 'Wastewater must be disposed of at the dump station in the parking lot or the service building'), read 2026-10-22

note: Marquette County park on the N shore of Lake Independence in Big Bay (Powell Twp), ~22 mi N of Marquette on CR-550. Swimming beach and boat launch; sites run from full hookup to rustic lakeside sites, plus rustic yurts. Registered campers may ride ATVs/ORVs on park roads between the campsite and the entrance. --Claude
summary: County park page, its rate page and the signed 2025 policies PDF confirm $30 electric / $40 E&W / $50 full hookup (2025 schedule, still posted; fees checked 2026->2025), $5 reservation fee, online booking via ResNexus with a 14-night max and a 3-night holiday minimum, next-season booking from Oct 1, showers and dump station. Phones 906-345-9353 (park) / 906-225-8197 (off-season) match. Not stated: amperage (50, note prose), site count 73 and max rig 60 ft (note prose), season dates - left. Note cleaned of the hookup/site/booking/phone text the fields hold.
